ev-kb-9f0c28fa9a07.summary:
[Runbook: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion > Runbook: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion > Capacity check before any pool change] Never change a pool size without checking the datastore:

`replicas × pool_max_per_replica + all other clients ≤ 90% of (max_connections − reserved)`

If ledger-db is already near capacity, a larger pool only moves the bottleneck into the database and
can exhaust `max_connections` for every client (including admin access). Treat a pool increase as a
short-lived containment step, never as the fix.

The incident was caused by a deployment (dep-ls-0291) of ledger-service v2.9.1 introducing a new endpoint that executes a slow sequential scan on `ledger_entries`, holding database connections for ~3 seconds.
